boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package certifies legal sufficiency or provides legal advice.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package identifies technical evidence refs and routes legal sufficiency to customer or external legal review.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package manages the AGM or confirms meeting governance completion.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package provides a generic governance checklist contract without customer answers.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package certifies the election system or customer process.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package provides public-safe validation inputs for deterministic checker review.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package records external auditor acceptance.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package can be consumed by external auditor review without publishing auditor notes.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package resolves public or state election readiness.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: Public/state readiness remains an external-boundary prerequisite routed through FEAT-149.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package grants production rollout approval.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package supports later promotion-owner review and does not grant rollout approval.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package makes or publishes customer governance decisions.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: Customer governance decisions remain customer-owned and private unless separately approved.

boundaries.forbiddenClaim: The package mutates the readiness register or claims final 95+ acceptance.
boundaries.allowedPublicWording: The package proposes RDY-DIM-010 8 -> 9 with direct register mutation disabled.
